goal.title: Your goal
goal.intro: Pick how many months of essentials you want in your fund, or type your own amount.
goal.noEssentials: Add your monthly essentials by retaking the quiz to pick a goal in months.
goal.growing: Your goal is now {goal}. The new part of your loaf starts rising from here.
goal.baked: Your goal is now {goal}. You've already saved that much, so your loaf is baked. Nice work.

habit.title: Your saving habit
habit.restartNote: Changing how often you're paid starts a new streak. Your breads and best streak stay.
habit.savedRestart: Your habit is saved. A new streak starts now, and your breads and best streak stay.

risk.title: Your investing answers
risk.intro: Your situation changed? Retake the risk quiz. There are no right answers, and it never changes your savings.

feedback.title: Send feedback
feedback.intro: Tell us what's working, what's confusing, or what you'd like to see.
feedback.label: Your feedback
feedback.privacy: Please don't include account numbers, card numbers, or other financial details.
feedback.failed: That didn't send. Check your connection and try again.
feedback.demoNote: This opens your email app with your message ready to send.

clearData.title: Clear app data
clearData.intro: For testing: wipe what Dough! has saved on this device.
clearData.askDemo: This clears everything Dough! has saved on this device: your demo loaf and answers, the app's saved files, and its offline copy. It can't be undone. Then the app starts over at the login screen.
clearData.askAccount: This clears everything Dough! has saved on this device, including the offline copy of your account, and signs you out here only. Your account and your loaf stay safe online, and you stay signed in on your other devices. Then the app starts over at the login screen.
clearData.failed: Some of it couldn't be cleared on this device. Close the app and try again.
